name: Armour facing
description: Gameplay change (off by default; Other Empires page, Gameplay changes). A ship's armour is thickest at the bow: a hit from ahead does 25% less damage, a hit from the side 10% more, and a hit from behind 40% more (the bow and stern arcs are 60 degrees to either side of the ship's heading). Bases and fixed targets have no facing. AI fleets turn a stationary ship's bow to the nearest enemy, and fast ships (30% or more faster than their target) circle to hit slower ships from the flank or rear instead of charging straight in.

flags.name: facingAI
flags.label: AI fleets turn their bows to the enemy and fast ships flank
flags.description: Off: the AI steers as usual (only the damage rule changes).
